title: Compress Video - Resize Video
summary: A powerful video compressor that can reduce video size without quality loss!
description:
This video compressor is the perfect solution for your video compression needs. With Compress Video, you can effortlessly reduce video size and making them easier to share or to save up storage space without compromising on video resolution. Batch compression feature helps making the process of video resizer quick and hassle-free.

Features:

- Compress video of any size: Tired of bulky video files gobbling up your storage space? Our app allows you to reduce video size with just a few taps, ensuring smooth playback and seamless sharing across all your devices and platforms.
- Resize video by levels: Offering customizable resizing options, choose from three convenient levels - Low, Medium or High - to tailor the video compression to your specific needs. Whether you're aiming for maximum savings in video size or striking the perfect balance between size and video resolution, our app puts the power in your hands.
- Batch video compressor: This video resizer allowing you to compress multiple videos simultaneously, saving you time and effort, whether you're organizing your video library or preparing content for a project, Compress Video will speed up the process for you.
- Advanced settings: Based on video size, Compress Video will also suggest best video compression setting for you. However, you can take full control of your compression process with advanced settings for bitrate, video resolution and frame rate.
- Free up space and share with ease: Let this video compressor helps you reduce video size, compress video just in seconds so you don't have to delete your favorite videos ever again. Directly send your video via email or share it to social media without worrying about it being too large.

How To Use
1. Choose videos you want to reduce size
2. Select video compression level or customize your resize video settings
3. Start auto video resizer process

With its user-friendly interface and powerful features, Compress Video is the go-to solution for anyone looking to resize video files with efficiency. Whether you're a professional videographer or a casual user, our app provides the tools you need to optimize your videos exactly the way you want.
